title: Smart India Hackathon 2026
description: A 36-hour national-level coding hackathon where students build cutting-edge solutions for real-world civic and industrial challenges.

title: Web3 & Blockchain Bootcamp
description: Hands-on masterclass covering Solidity, decentralized apps (dApps), and smart contract security with live deployment on testnets.

title: Spandan Annual Cultural Fest
description: The flagship annual cultural extravaganza of the university featuring musical bands, street play competitions, fashion showcases, and food carnivals.

title: AI & Deep Learning Symposium
description: Distinguished industry keynote speakers from Google and NVIDIA share trends in foundation models, computer vision, and autonomous agents.

title: Inter-College Cricket Cup
description: 16 collegiate teams compete over five days in a T20 knockout format for the prestigious Chancellor's Trophy.

title: Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking
description: Learn network defense, OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities, digital forensics, and participate in a live Capture the Flag (CTF) showdown.

title: Career Catalyst: Mock Interviews & Resume Clinic
description: Alumni and HR leaders conduct 1-on-1 resume critiques, behavioral interviews, and technical screening practice sessions for pre-final and final year students.

title: Robotics Battle Arena: RoboWars 2026
description: Custom combat robots duel in a reinforced arena with traps and hazards. Category includes 15kg featherweight and 30kg combat bots.

title: Photography & Filmmaking Workshop
description: Master camera exposure, lighting setups, cinematic composition, and color grading using industry-standard tools like Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.

title: Cloud Architecture on AWS & GCP
description: Comprehensive exploration of serverless architectures, microservices, containerization with Docker & Kubernetes, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

title: EcoGreen Sustainability Drive
description: Tree plantation drive, e-waste collection campaign, and interactive awareness sessions on circular economy and renewable energy solutions.

title: E-Summit & Startup Pitch Fest
description: Connect student founders with angel investors, VC firms, and mentors. Featuring live pitch battles with seed funding awards up to INR 5 Lakhs.

title: Chess Grandmasters Championship
description: Rapid and Blitz Swiss-system chess tournament officiated by FIDE rated arbiters with cash prizes and university ranking points.

title: Mobile App Dev with Flutter & Dart
description: Learn cross-platform mobile development, reactive state management using Riverpod, and REST API consumption with dynamic JSON parsing.

title: Debate & Model United Nations (MUN)
description: Three days of intense diplomatic debate simulating UN Security Council, WHO, and General Assembly committees addressing urgent global affairs.

title: FinTech & Algorithmic Trading Summit
description: Discover quantitative analysis, quantitative finance modeling with Python, backtesting strategies, and modern algorithmic trading infrastructure.
